content.text: In Zimbabwe, many digital creators face the harsh reality of being cut off from global payment processing platforms like Stripe and PayPal. This financial isolation limits your ability to monetize your work, leaving you at the mercy of cumbersome alternatives. The goal is to reclaim your sovereignty in digital commerce by deploying a fully operational store on Cloudflare Pages. This [[LINK:https://coremerch.[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/github-pages-free-digital-product-store-hosting-explained-12|COREMERCH guide to github]].io/store/blog/nonsense-guide-how-start-selling-digital-products-crypto-12|[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/nonsense-guide-payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-stripe-3|The No-Nonsense]]]] guide will take you through the steps required to set up your digital storefront without relying on restricted payment gateways. With the right infrastructure, you can provide your audience with seamless access to your digital products while ensuring you retain complete ownership over your assets. It’s time to build an independent commerce solution that works for you.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The traditional e-commerce platforms like Stripe and PayPal are often inaccessible in regions facing economic challenges. They impose restrictions that prevent creators in Zimbabwe from leveraging their skills to make a legitimate income. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack offers a robust alternative by utilizing Cloudflare Pages for hosting, which is reliable and free. You gain not only a platform that is always available but also one where you retain full ownership of your data. With NOWPayments, you can easily accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, providing you and your customers with a diverse range of options that are impervious to any currency collapse or governmental restrictions. This architecture ensures that you’re not just setting up a store; you’re establishing a resilient commerce infrastructure tailored to your needs.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can deploy your digital store, it is essential to gather the necessary resources and tools. First, ensure you have a GitHub account for version control and hosting your files. Next, set up a Cloudflare account for using their Pages service, enabling you to host your storefront seamlessly. Additionally, create a NOWPayments account to facilitate cryptocurrency transactions without the burden of KYC or buyer accounts. Collect and prepare your digital products, such as eBooks, courses, or software, and ensure they are ready for upload. Familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script, as you will use it for backend functionalities, including order tracking and payment confirmations. With these pieces in place, you are well-equipped to move into the deployment phase.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, begin by configuring your NOWPayments account. You’ll need to integrate your cryptocurrency wallet to receive payments. Follow the NOWPayments integration guide to ensure a smooth connection between your storefront and the payment processor. Next, establish your delivery pipeline using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to host your digital products. Upload your products and generate shareable links that will be used for automated delivery. Using Google Apps Script, create functions that trigger once a payment is confirmed, enabling automatic access to your products for buyers. This streamlined payment and delivery process will keep your customers satisfied while ensuring you receive payments without delay.
Reclaim your financial sovereignty with resilient infrastructure.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it’s time to go live. Push your codebase to Cloudflare Pages and verify that your store is accessible. Test your payment processing by creating a test product and making a purchase using a cryptocurrency wallet. Confirm that the payment processes correctly through NOWPayments, and monitor the automated delivery to ensure customers receive their products directly upon purchase. This is a crucial step to identify any potential issues with the system before officially launching. Once you’ve confirmed that everything runs smoothly, promote your store through social media platforms and engage your audience directly to boost your initial sales. Your first transaction will set the tone for future sales.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your digital store operational, focus on scaling your infrastructure to accommodate growth. Start by analyzing traffic patterns and sales metrics to understand your customer base better. You can add more digital products to your store by simply uploading them to your chosen delivery platform and updating the links in your store. Explore partnerships with other creators or influencers to widen your reach. Automate repetitive processes using Google Apps Script to save time and effort. As revenue increases, consider investing in paid marketing strategies to enhance visibility. You now have a sovereign e-commerce solution that can grow with you, allowing you to pivot as your needs evolve.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

Deploying your digital store on Cloudflare Pages is a straightforward process designed for creators who can’t access conventional payment systems. By using the Edge Commerce Stack, you establish a resilient infrastructure that allows you to host your products, process payments seamlessly via cryptocurrency, and retain total control over your digital assets. This approach positions you as a sovereign creator in the digital marketplace, ready to serve your audience while navigating financial restrictions.
No subscriptions, no dependencies — just pure ownership.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The Edge Commerce Stack, priced at $197, is your comprehensive solution for deploying a robust digital store. With Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and NOWPayments, you can have an operational e-commerce platform in 48 hours. This stack not only equips you with essential tools but also ensures your infrastructure is resilient and adaptable to your needs as a digital creator.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Sign up for a GitHub account to host your codebase. 2. Create a Cloudflare account to access their Pages service. 3. Register with NOWPayments for cryptocurrency payment processing. 4. Prepare your digital products for sale, ensuring they are in the correct format. 5. Upload your files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 6. Create a Google Apps Script for order management and automatic payment confirmations. 7. Test your setup with a trial product to ensure everything operates smoothly. 8. Go live with your store and promote it through your channels.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I really deploy a store without Stripe or PayPal?
Yes, with the Edge Commerce Stack, you can successfully deploy a store using Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments, which do not rely on traditional payment platforms.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to offer various payment options to your customers, ensuring flexibility in transactions.
How do I set up automated product delivery?
Using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for hosting, upload your digital products and create shareable links to automate delivery upon payment confirmation.
Is there ongoing support after deployment?
Yes, the Edge Commerce Stack includes 30 days of support to help you troubleshoot and optimize your setup after deployment.
What if I need to scale my store later?
Scaling your store is straightforward; simply add more products and automate processes to accommodate growth as your business evolves.
Build a future-proof digital store that grows with you.
